plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Spanish (BA) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Spanish & Spanish Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Spanish (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints Total Credits, BA Degree: 120 (BA only; no BS version is published for Spanish), which the map matches exactly. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/14/15/15/15/15/15/15) and the plan to 120. The catalog's BA Degree Requirement is 16 credits of a single foreign language (or a foreign-language minor); for this major the map satisfies the degree through the Spanish sequence itself and prints no separate language block. Cross-check: the catalog's Spanish Curriculum totals 40 credits (Required Courses 22: SPAN 1010, 1020, 2010, 2020 at 4 credits each plus SPAN 3210 and SPAN 3300 at 3 each; Spanish Electives 18), and every named required course appears in the map. The map places SPAN 1020 where the catalog allows SPAN 1020 or SPAN 1030 (Beginning Spanish II for Spanish Speakers); transcribed as printed. The map's six generic Spanish upper-division elective rows total exactly the catalog's 18 elective credits and are recorded as choice slots carrying the catalog's elective list. The catalog's free-elective total is computed as 120 minus major, GE and degree-requirement credits; the map's generic Free Elective and Free Upper-division Elective rows are transcribed at their printed credits. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
